definitions.short: Reuel , the name of Moses' father-in-law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite
definitions.full: H7467. Reuel רְעוּאֵל proper name, masculine Ραγουηλ : 1 Moses' father-in-law Exod 2:18 (J; ᵐ5 L Ιοθορ ), Num 10:29 (JE); elsewhere יִתְרוֺ q. v. 2 Edomite Gen 36:4 , 10 , 13 , 17 (twice in verse) (P), || 1Chr 1:35 , 37 . 3 Gadite Num 2:14 , see דְּעוּאל p. 396. 4 Benjamite 1Chr 9:8 .

occurrences.englishText: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
“The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
